blocks.en_text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English
blocks.zh_text: 大家好，欢迎来到Real Easy English

blocks.en_text: In this podcast, we have real conversations
blocks.zh_text: 在这个播客里，我们进行真实的对话

blocks.en_text: in easy English to help you learn.
blocks.zh_text: 用简单的英语来帮助大家学习。

blocks.en_text: I'm Georgie.
blocks.zh_text: 我是Georgie。

blocks.en_text: And I'm Beth.
blocks.zh_text: 我是Beth。

blocks.en_text: You can find a video of this podcast
blocks.zh_text: 你可以在我们的网站上找到这个播客的视频

blocks.en_text: and a worksheet to help you learn on our website,
blocks.zh_text: 和帮助你学习的练习表，

blocks.en_text: bbclearningenglish.com.
blocks.zh_text: 网址是bbclearningenglish.com。

blocks.en_text: Hi Beth. How are you today?
blocks.zh_text: 嗨，Beth。你今天怎么样？

blocks.en_text: I'm good, thank you.
blocks.zh_text: 我很好，谢谢。

blocks.en_text: I am very busy.
blocks.zh_text: 我非常忙。

blocks.en_text: I have a lot of meetings.
blocks.zh_text: 我有很多会议。

blocks.en_text: How are you?
blocks.zh_text: 你怎么样？

blocks.en_text: I'm OK, thank you, Beth,
blocks.zh_text: 我挺好的，谢谢你，Beth，

blocks.en_text: I don't have many meetings today.
blocks.zh_text: 我今天没有很多会议。

blocks.en_text: But today we are talking about meetings – in particular work meetings,
blocks.zh_text: 不过今天我们要聊的是会议——特别是工作会议，

blocks.en_text: where you talk to colleagues and discuss ideas or make decisions.
blocks.zh_text: 就是你和同事交谈、讨论想法或者做决定的那种会议。

blocks.en_text: That's right. OK.
blocks.zh_text: 没错。好。

blocks.en_text: Shall we get started?
blocks.zh_text: 我们开始吧？

blocks.en_text: Yes. So, Beth, you have a lot of meetings today.
blocks.zh_text: 好的。那么，Beth，你今天有很多会议。

blocks.en_text: Do you generally have a lot of meetings at work?
blocks.zh_text: 你平时工作上会议多吗？

blocks.en_text: It really depends on what I'm working on.
blocks.zh_text: 这真的要看我在做什么工作。

blocks.en_text: So, if I have a project where I need to meet a lot of people,
blocks.zh_text: 所以，如果我有一个项目需要见很多人，

blocks.en_text: then I might have quite a few meetings.
blocks.zh_text: 那我可能就会有不少会议。

blocks.en_text: And that's why I'm busy now.
blocks.zh_text: 这就是我现在很忙的原因。

blocks.en_text: But generally, we have a lot of...
blocks.zh_text: 但一般来说，我们有很多……

blocks.en_text: a few meetings together as a team,
blocks.zh_text: 作为一个团队，我们会一起开一些会，

blocks.en_text: but I don't think we have loads of meetings.
blocks.zh_text: 但我觉得我们的会议不算特别多。

blocks.en_text: Compared to other jobs, I don't think we have many meetings.
blocks.zh_text: 和其他工作相比，我觉得我们的会议不算多。

blocks.en_text: Most of our work is producing things and editing and writing.
blocks.zh_text: 我们大部分工作是制作内容、编辑和写作。

blocks.en_text: But you're right. When there are lots
blocks.zh_text: 但你说得对。当有很多

blocks.en_text: of big projects that we need to talk to other people on the project,
blocks.zh_text: 大项目，需要我们和项目里的其他人沟通时，

blocks.en_text: we have more meetings.
blocks.zh_text: 我们的会议就会更多。

blocks.en_text: But yeah, like you, it really depends.
blocks.zh_text: 不过是的，跟你一样，这真的要看情况。

blocks.en_text: So, when do you think meetings are useful?
blocks.zh_text: 那么，你觉得会议什么时候有用？

blocks.en_text: I think when you need to brainstorm.
blocks.zh_text: 我觉得当你需要头脑风暴的时候。

blocks.en_text: So, a brainstorm is when you have lots of new ideas and
blocks.zh_text: 头脑风暴就是当你有很多新想法，

blocks.en_text: you need to talk about them together.
blocks.zh_text: 需要大家一起讨论的时候。

blocks.en_text: I think then meetings are really useful because you hear lots of new ideas,
blocks.zh_text: 我觉得那时候会议真的很有用，因为你能听到很多新想法，

blocks.en_text: and when you're in a room with other people, if,
blocks.zh_text: 当你和其他人待在一个房间里，如果，

blocks.en_text: for example, I have an idea and you say, that's good,
blocks.zh_text: 比如说，我有个想法，你说这个不错，

blocks.en_text: and we can also do this and we can all work together,
blocks.zh_text: 我们还可以这样做，我们可以一起合作，

blocks.en_text: and I think those kind of meetings are really useful.
blocks.zh_text: 我觉得那种会议真的很有用。

blocks.en_text: Yeah, I think that way of doing it is also more efficient.
blocks.zh_text: 是的，我觉得那种做法也更高效。

blocks.en_text: So, sometimes it's better to just have one hour,
blocks.zh_text: 所以，有时候更好的做法就是花一个小时，

blocks.en_text: come up with ideas and decide on the ideas.
blocks.zh_text: 想出点子，然后把这些点子定下来。

blocks.en_text: Yeah, definitely.
blocks.zh_text: 是的，绝对是这样。

blocks.en_text: Do you tend to speak up in meetings?
blocks.zh_text: 你在会议上通常会积极发言吗？

blocks.en_text: So, that means do you ask questions and feel confident to speak?
blocks.zh_text: 那么，这是说你会提问，而且有信心发言吗？

blocks.en_text: I think, if the meeting has lots of people,
blocks.zh_text: 我觉得，如果会议人很多的话，

blocks.en_text: I find it a bit more stressful to speak up
blocks.zh_text: 我会觉得开口发言有点更有压力，

blocks.en_text: because I get a bit nervous to speak in front of lots of people.
blocks.zh_text: 因为在一大群人面前说话我会有点紧张。

blocks.en_text: But if it's a meeting with just our team,
blocks.zh_text: 但如果是只有我们团队的会议，

blocks.en_text: for example, you guys I like and trust,
blocks.zh_text: 比如说，你们这些我喜欢又信任的人，

blocks.en_text: I... I don't mind speaking up that much.
blocks.zh_text: 我……我不太介意发言。

blocks.en_text: And sometimes we have meetings in person.
blocks.zh_text: 有时候我们开面对面的会议。

blocks.en_text: Sometimes you have meetings on a call.
blocks.zh_text: 有时候你们通过通话开会。

blocks.en_text: So a video call. Do you prefer meeting in person or having calls?
blocks.zh_text: 也就是视频通话。你更喜欢面对面开会还是打电话？

blocks.en_text: I think I prefer meetings in person because you can... you can kind of see
blocks.zh_text: 我觉得我更喜欢面对面开会，因为你能……你能比较容易地看到

blocks.en_text: the facial expressions and body language more easily, I think.
blocks.zh_text: 面部表情和肢体语言，我觉得。

blocks.en_text: And it's easier to know when a person wants to speak –
blocks.zh_text: 而且更容易知道一个人什么时候想发言——

blocks.en_text: these kinds of things.
blocks.zh_text: 这类的事情。

blocks.en_text: Yeah. No, I agree with what you're saying.
blocks.zh_text: 对。不，我同意你说的。

blocks.en_text: A lot of the meetings that I have had recently have been
blocks.zh_text: 我最近开的很多会议都是

blocks.en_text: with people in different time zones in different countries.
blocks.zh_text: 和不同国家、不同时区的人一起开的。

blocks.en_text: So, definitely then a call is better
blocks.zh_text: 所以，那种情况下肯定是打电话更好，

blocks.en_text: because it's the best way to speak
blocks.zh_text: 因为这是最好的交流方式，

blocks.en_text: without having to go to different countries.
blocks.zh_text: 不用跑到不同的国家去。

blocks.en_text: But I agree, I think it's nice to be able to see body language better
blocks.zh_text: 但我同意，我觉得在面对面会议里能更好地看到肢体语言是很好的，

blocks.en_text: in a face-to-face meeting,
blocks.zh_text: 在面对面会议里，

blocks.en_text: but meetings on calls now are so normal that there's not loads of difference.
blocks.zh_text: 不过现在电话会议太常见了，所以差别也不大。

blocks.en_text: It is also really nice to be able to take calls in your own house.
blocks.zh_text: 能在自己家里接电话也真的很不错。

blocks.en_text: So, working from home can be really nice because you can have your snacks
blocks.zh_text: 所以，在家工作可以很舒服，因为你可以把零食

blocks.en_text: and drinks nearby.
blocks.zh_text: 和饮料放在旁边。

blocks.en_text: So, yeah, they both have their pros and cons.
blocks.zh_text: 所以，对，两者各有优缺点。

blocks.en_text: That's true.
blocks.zh_text: 没错。

blocks.en_text: OK. Let's recap the language we heard during the conversation,
blocks.zh_text: 好。我们来回顾一下对话中听到的语言，

blocks.en_text: starting with 'brainstorm',
blocks.zh_text: 从“brainstorm（头脑风暴）”开始，

blocks.en_text: which is when you get together with a group of people to come up with ideas.
blocks.zh_text: 它指的是你和一群人聚在一起想点子。

blocks.en_text: If you 'speak up' in a meeting, you express your opinion using your voice.
blocks.zh_text: 如果你在会议上“speak up（开口发言）”，就是用你的声音表达你的观点。

blocks.en_text: In an 'in-person' meeting, everyone is in the same physical place.
blocks.zh_text: 在“in-person（面对面）”会议中，每个人都在同一个实际地点。

blocks.en_text: We can also call this a 'face-to-face' meeting.
blocks.zh_text: 我们也可以把这叫做“face-to-face（面对面）”会议。

blocks.en_text: And we also talked about 'having a call'.
blocks.zh_text: 我们还谈到了“having a call（打电话/通话）”。

blocks.en_text: This could be a phone call or a video call.
blocks.zh_text: 这可以是电话通话，也可以是视频通话。

blocks.en_text: And we can also describe this as a 'remote' meeting.
blocks.zh_text: 我们也可以把这描述为“remote（远程）”会议。

blocks.en_text: That's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
blocks.zh_text: 这就是本期 Real Easy English 的全部内容。

blocks.en_text: Why not test what you've learned using the worksheet on our website,
blocks.zh_text: 为什么不用我们网站上的练习表测试一下你学到的东西呢，

blocks.en_text: bbclearningenglish.com.
blocks.zh_text: bbclearningenglish.com。

blocks.en_text: And we'll be back next week with another conversation in easy English.
blocks.zh_text: 我们下周会带着另一段简单英语对话回来。

blocks.en_text: See you then.
blocks.zh_text: 到时候见。

blocks.en_text: Goodbye!
blocks.zh_text: 再见！
